products.name: MyClaw 3.0
products.tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
products.description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

products.name: QA.tech MCP
products.tagline: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents
products.description: QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

products.name: Airbot
products.tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
products.description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

products.name: Hiring Right Now
products.description: Paste your LinkedIn. Backdoor reads your work, searches growing startups and shows you the ones that fit, the founder to write to, and the email to send them. Free, no signup required, takes about two minutes.

products.name: Canva MCP
products.tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
products.description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

products.name: Snag by Parallel
products.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
products.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

products.name: Fompi
products.tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
products.description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

products.name: Koed
products.description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

products.name: Clary
products.tagline: iOS notifications in sender's own voice from WhatsApp & more
products.description: Clary reads your iPhone notifications in the sender's own voice, from WhatsApp, iMessage and more. It uses voice cloning: each person records 20 seconds once, from a link, and agrees first, then Clary makes their voice on your iPhone. Tap a message to hear it in their voice, so you feel closer to your people. It also keeps your notifications as a history on your iPhone, sorted Gmail-style into Messages, Updates and Promotions. Free: history, sorting and 2 plays. Needs iPhone 15 Pro+ and iOS 27.

products.name: Hai
products.tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
products.description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

products.name: Monton
products.tagline: AI agents that do your agency's busywork
products.description: Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

products.name: Omi X 2.0
products.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
products.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

products.name: RelayRunner
products.tagline: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.
products.description: RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

products.name: MAGI-2
products.tagline: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation
products.description: MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

products.name: Ground
products.tagline: Generate high quality synthetic data for testing or training
products.description: Ground turns a one-sentence description into consistent synthetic tables where every key, total and rate holds, or extends a dataset you already have. One sentence produced 72,365 rows with 0 orphan keys; asked for ~5% overdue, it delivered. Use it in the browser, via API, or from Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT through its MCP server. If you need human written level data at scale Ground has you covered.
